messages:
sam: Heads-up — nightly staging image publish failed during the post-publish validation. Deploybot rejected the manifest due to a missing build timestamp annotation :warning:

deploy-bot: automated: Publish of image gcr.io/redwood-staging/service-a@sha256:abc123 failed validation: missing annotation 'org.redwood.buildtime' -> reject. See: https://gcr.io/errors/manifest-invalid :no_entry:

kevin: ugh. was this the new nightly that includes the kernel patch?

sam: yes, that one. The CI build completed and we got a successful cosign attestation, but GCR gate failed on our provenance lint. log: ```error: manifest invalid: required annotation 'org.redwood.buildtime' not found
metadata: {"build_id":"ci-2026-03-20-07","author":"ci-bot"}```

olivia: do we still have the previous pinned digest in the staging tag?

maria: checking... staging:service-a currently points to sha256:ffb7c9 (last night's green). we can pin that for the release window if needed. :thumbsup:

release-coordinator: Decision: hold the release window until manual republish. If we need to ship hotfixes, we'll pin to the previous digest and open a manual deploy window.

kevin: action items: 1) Disable automatic promotion for this pipeline until we fix the annotation. 2) Manually republish a corrected image with the annotation, then re-run attestation. 3) If republish is delayed > 2 hours, pin staging route to sha256:ffb7c9 and notify customers.

sam: I can patch the build pipeline to ensure org.redwood.buildtime is injected (it's a 1-line change). Will try a manual republish after patch. ETA ~30m.

maria: I will lock the deploybot to prevent auto-promote for this job. Running: `deploybot lock job=service-a-nightly reason="missing buildtime annotation"`

deploy-bot: automated: Lock acquired for job=service-a-nightly by maria. Auto-promote disabled.

olivia: release-notes folks — hold off on publishing the window notes until we confirm republish. If we pin, note the pinned digest and rationale.

release-coordinator: Noted. I'll draft a short blurb: "Release window held due to staging image metadata validation failure; republish in progress or pinned to previous digest if delayed."

kevin: also file a quick postmortem link so we can track root cause (likely a recent change in the buildpack that dropped the annotation).

sam: republish attempt done — the new image includes org.redwood.buildtime. Running cosign and provenance lint now.

deploy-bot: automated: Received republish request for gcr.io/redwood-staging/service-a. Running validation...

deploy-bot: automated: Validation passed. Image gcr.io/redwood-staging/service-a@sha256:de9f45 accepted. Promotion still locked; manual promote required.

maria: manual promote started to staging tag -> will coordinate canary rollout for 15 minutes.

olivia: will wait to update release notes until the canary looks good. Can we keep a rollback plan?

kevin: rollback plan: if canary error rate > 1% or latency regresses > 15% in 15m, revert to pinned sha256:ffb7c9 and notify infra oncall.

release-coordinator: I'll send the change-window update: republish succeeded, manual promote in progress, canary policy attached, will update release notes post-canary.

sam: thanks everyone. I'll open a short PR to ensure the buildpack always writes the buildtime annotation and add a unit test. PR link: https://git.redwood/inference/ci-packs/pull/42 :eyes:

kevin: great. mark this thread resolved once release notes are updated.

maria: resolved for now — canary healthy at +10m. leaving promote in place.

release-coordinator: closing the hold. Documenting the pin and republish in the release history.

sam: filing follow-up ticket to add a lint step earlier in CI to fail fast if annotations missing (reduce noisy publish fails).
